questions.questionText: Which of the following is not an aspect of URL optimization?
questions.explanation: URL size (file size) is not an aspect of URL optimization; naming, structure, and length are standard optimization factors.

questions.questionText: _____analysis should be done regularly to maintain the health of Website
questions.explanation: Regular backlink analysis is essential to identify and disavow toxic links and monitor link equity.

questions.questionText: ______refers to optimizing a website for search queries from mobile devices
questions.explanation: Mobile SEO specifically focuses on optimizing the viewing experience and search ranking for mobile device queries.

questions.questionText: _____refers to the exact location of a file or Web
questions.explanation: In a URL, the Path indicates the exact location of a file, page, or directory on the host server.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a component of search engine?
questions.explanation: The three fundamental components of a search engine are the Web Crawler (spider), Database (index), and Search Interface/Algorithm.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a dominant leader in Internet searches?
questions.explanation: Google is the dominant global market leader in internet searches.

questions.questionText: When was Google first introduced as a search engine?
questions.explanation: Google was founded in 1998 by Larry Page and Sergey Brin.

questions.questionText: ______refers to the process of getting links from other Websites to one’s own site.
questions.explanation: Link Building is the process of acquiring inbound hyperlinks from other websites to your own.

questions.questionText: ______determines how data is transferred between the host and Web browser.
questions.explanation: A communication protocol (such as HTTP or HTTPS) governs how data packets are transmitted between the server and the browser.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not an Off-page SEO strategy?
questions.explanation: Tag Optimization (title tags, meta descriptions, heading tags) is an on-page SEO technique, not off-page.

questions.questionText: What can you do by placing a $ before a number in a search query with Google?
questions.explanation: Placing a '$' sign in front of a number in Google searches filters for prices (e.g. '$50 shoes').

questions.questionText: Which do search engines use to rank the results by most relevant to least relevant?
questions.explanation: Search engines use sophisticated ranking algorithms to score and order results by relevance and quality.

questions.questionText: What should Sarah do to ensure that her Web pages are read by Google? (multiple correct)
options: Submit Website in Google Search Console
Use the right amount of details
questions.correctAnswer: Submit Website in Google Search Console
questions.explanation: Submitting a sitemap and site URL in Google Search Console is the direct way to inform Google to crawl and read web pages.

questions.questionText: You want to view estimates on the number of searches a keyword gets. Which one of the following tools will you use?
questions.explanation: Google Keyword Planner provides estimated monthly search volumes and competition for target keywords.

questions.questionText: Query or search terms given by the users are called
questions.explanation: Words, phrases, or search terms typed into a search engine by users are known as keywords.

questions.questionText: Google provides a tool called ______ to help users with new keywords.
questions.explanation: Google Keyword Planner is Google's official free keyword research tool inside Google Ads.

questions.questionText: SEO is unethical and is created against search engine guidelines
questions.explanation: Black Hat SEO employs manipulative tactics that directly violate search engine webmaster guidelines.

questions.questionText: A good search engine rank indicates_____(multiple correct)
options: Increase in the number of organic visitors
Greater chances of content being shared on social media
questions.correctAnswer: Increase in the number of organic visitors
questions.explanation: Achieving top search rankings directly increases the volume of free, organic visitors to the website.

questions.questionText: What can you do by placing a $ before a number in a search query with Google?
questions.explanation: Placing a '$' prefix before a number searches specifically for prices.

questions.questionText: Nancy is checking the method through which a visitor arrives at a Web page. What is she looking at?
questions.explanation: In web analytics, 'Medium' represents the general mechanism or method of traffic arrival (e.g. organic, cpc, referral, email).

questions.questionText: John is using the technique of cloaking for SEO ranking. What will this technique do?
options: Copy content from a different Website and publish on owner's site
Show different content to users and different content to search engines
Use synonyms of keywords at different places in a blog
Ensure proper internal links for navigation
questions.correctAnswer: Show different content to users and different content to search engines
questions.explanation: Cloaking is a deceptive Black Hat technique that serves one piece of content to search engine crawlers and a different one to human users.

questions.questionText: Which of the following technologies are used by Responsive Web Design to resize, hide, shrink, enlarge, and move the content on any screen?
questions.explanation: Responsive Web Design combines HTML structure and CSS media queries / flexible grids to adapt content to various screen dimensions.

questions.questionText: ________is used to arrange the grid columns in proportion based on page element sizing
questions.explanation: A Fluid Grid sizes page columns using percentage proportions rather than fixed pixel dimensions.

questions.questionText: Content audit should always be recorded in a _______mainly because they are flexible.
questions.explanation: Spreadsheets provide flexible rows, columns, and filtering to organize inventory and audit metrics.

questions.questionText: _______concentrates on setting up an engaging interface with logic behaviours
questions.explanation: Interaction Design (IxD) focuses on crafting intuitive user experiences with well-defined behaviors and actions.

questions.questionText: ________is a navigation aid that allows the user to keep track of the location within programs.
questions.explanation: Breadcrumbs display the current page hierarchy and trail, enabling users to keep track of where they are on a website.

questions.questionText: Which of the following principles emphasizes the importance of designing the user interface to prevent users from making errors.
questions.explanation: The Tolerance Principle emphasizes flexibility and error prevention, making the interface forgiving of user mistakes.

questions.questionText: Which layer of the Progressive Enhancement uses JavaScript for improved usability?
questions.explanation: Progressive Enhancement layers: 1st layer is HTML (content), 2nd layer is CSS (presentation), and 3rd layer is JavaScript (behavior & usability).

questions.questionText: Which phase of the Responsive Work Design workflow consists of the processes called UX sketches and Interaction design?
questions.explanation: UX sketches, wireframing, and interaction design are core components of the Design phase.

questions.questionText: Which phase of the Responsive Work Design workflow consists of the processes called content migration and user acceptance testing?
questions.explanation: Content migration, user acceptance testing (UAT), and release preparation take place in the Deploy phase.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not the normal screen width for designers?
questions.explanation: Standard device breakpoints are 320px (mobile), 760/768px (tablet), and 960/1024px (desktop); 460px is non-standard.

questions.questionText: An adaptable matrix can be made using________
questions.explanation: CSS3 layout modules (such as CSS Grid and Flexbox) provide adaptable matrix and layout capabilities.

questions.questionText: The______ tag is used for displaying information about the data.
questions.explanation: The <meta> tag defines metadata—information about the HTML document itself.

questions.questionText: Identify the satellite navigation system that provides information about the location from any part of the globe.
questions.explanation: GPS (Global Positioning System) is a satellite-based navigation network that pinpoints global location.

questions.questionText: The_______element is a column or a section that generally contains data linked to the main information but not as relevant or important as the main information.
questions.explanation: The HTML5 <aside> element defines tangentially related content or sidebars.

questions.questionText: The______ element emphasizes the text as compared to its surrounding text
questions.explanation: The <strong> tag indicates strong importance and emphasizes text relative to surrounding content.

questions.questionText: Identify the correct syntax of doctype in HTML5.
questions.explanation: The standard, case-insensitive doctype declaration for HTML5 is <!DOCTYPE html>.

questions.questionText: _____property of the navigator object retrieves the version number and platform of the browser.
questions.explanation: navigator.appVersion retrieves the browser version and operating platform.

questions.questionText: _______styles are placed inside the <head> section of a particular Web page source code.
questions.explanation: Internal style sheets are written inside <style> tags within the HTML <head> section.

questions.questionText: Which of the following browsers require the -web kit-prefix to support CSS3 transitions?
questions.explanation: Apple Safari 3.1 was the pioneering browser to implement CSS3 transitions with the -webkit- prefix.

questions.questionText: Which of the following options are valid values that can be assigned to the text-decoration property?
questions.explanation: In CSS, valid text-decoration values are none, underline, overline, and line-through (strike-through is invalid syntax).

questions.questionText: Which of the following options is a text-level semantic tag?
questions.explanation: The <mark> element represents inline highlighted/marked text, functioning as a text-level semantic tag.

questions.questionText: HTML5 Canvas allows the user to create quadratic curves using the______method.
questions.explanation: The 2D canvas API provides quadraticCurveTo(cpx, cpy, x, y) for drawing quadratic Bézier curves.

questions.questionText: Identify the correct syntax of the <embed> tag to insert an external file into an HTML page.
questions.explanation: The <embed> element specifies media using the src attribute: <embed src="sample.mp3" />.

questions.questionText:
Identify the correct syntax for specifying an inline style for the

tag.
questions.explanation: Inline styling is specified via the style attribute on the HTML element.

questions.questionText: Identify the correct syntax for specifying a background image in an HTML Web page.
questions.explanation: In classic HTML, the background attribute on the <body> element loads an image background.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not an Off-page SEO strategy?
questions.explanation: Tag Optimization is strictly an on-page SEO practice.

questions.questionText: __________report provides a summary of the user experience of visitors
questions.explanation: Google Search Console's Page Experience report summarizes Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, and security signals.

questions.questionText: Link generation using microsites is a practice of_________SEO.
questions.explanation: Creating networks of microsites to artificially inflate link equity is considered a Black Hat link scheme.

questions.questionText: ______is a set of metrics for loading speed, responsiveness, and visual stability to measure user experience on the Web.
questions.explanation: Core Web Vitals quantify real-world user experience across loading (LCP), interactivity (INP/FID), and layout stability (CLS).

questions.questionText: ________ is the first thing that visitors see in search results
questions.explanation: The HTML <title> tag serves as the prominent clickable headline in search engine result pages.

questions.questionText: _____indicates organized topics in relevant categories
questions.explanation: A clean, hierarchical URL structure groups topics logically into intuitive folders and categories.

questions.questionText: A_______tells the search engine crawlers about URLs that they can access from the site.
questions.explanation: The robots.txt file specifies directives controlling which sections search engine bots may crawl.

questions.questionText: Why does Google recommend to use a responsive Web design? (multiple correct)
options: For a reduced engineering time to maintain multiple pages for the same content
To easily share content with a single URL
For a single Googlebot user agent to crawl the page once
For automatic conversion of negative space
questions.correctAnswer: To easily share content with a single URL
questions.explanation: Responsive web design allows users to link and share content seamlessly using a single, unified URL across all devices.
